proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D _ _ h
  have h2 : D -ᵥ A = C -ᵥ B := by
    have := vsub_sub_vsub_comm B A C D
    rw [h, sub_self] at this
    have h3 := sub_eq_zero.mp this.symm
    rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev A D, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev B C, ← h3]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [dist_comm A B, dist_comm D C, dist_eq_norm_vsub V B A, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C D, h]
  · rw [dist_comm A D, dist_comm B C, dist_eq_norm_vsub V D A, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C B, h2]
  · rw [midpoint_eq_midpoint_iff_vsub_eq_vsub, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev B A, h, neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev]
  · unfold EuclideanGeometry.angle
    rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev B A, h, ← h2, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev A D, InnerProductGeometry.angle_neg_neg]
  · unfold EuclideanGeometry.angle
    rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C B, ← h2, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C D, ← h, InnerProductGeometry.angle_neg_neg]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), A ≠ B → A ≠ D → B -ᵥ A = C -ᵥ D → dist A B = dist D C ∧ dist A D = dist B C ∧ midpoint ℝ A C = midpoint ℝ B D ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C = EuclideanGeometry.angle C D A ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle B C D = EuclideanGeometry.angle D A B
